1.hook: Would your child know what to tell the ambulance?
1.description: Your child comes home to find you unresponsive on the floor. Bobby will guide them through checking if you're breathing, giving the address, and staying calm until help arrives.
practicePoints: Staying on the line until help arrives

2.situation: You wake up and smell smoke
2.hook: Get out first? Call first? Do they know?
2.description: It's the middle of the night and smoke fills the hallway. Bobby teaches them the right order of actions and how to escape safely.

3.situation: There's a stranger in the house
3.hook: Could they stay hidden and whisper for help?
3.description: Someone has broken in while the family is home. Bobby helps them understand how to hide, stay quiet, and communicate with emergency services.

4.situation: Grandad fell and won't get up
4.hook: Can they describe what happened clearly?
4.description: Grandad has had a fall and can't move. Bobby guides them through describing the situation, checking for injuries, and keeping Grandad comfortable.

5.situation: The neighbour's house is on fire
5.hook: Do they know what THEY should do?
5.description: Flames are visible next door. Bobby teaches them to alert their own family, call for help, and stay away from danger.

1.question: What is this app for?
1.answer: Bobby helps kids practice calling 999 in a safe, fun way. It teaches children how to communicate clearly, stay calm, and understand when and how to call for help.

2.question: How do the age scenarios work?
2.answer: The app offers three age tiers: Ages 5-7 (very simple language and short scenarios), Ages 8-10 (more realistic conversations), and Ages 11-12 (near-realistic operator flow).

3.question: Will this call real emergency services?
3.answer: No! Bobby is a training app only - it will NEVER connect to real emergency services. It's a safe environment for practice.

4.question: How many practice calls are included?
4.answer: Each credit gives you one practice call with Bobby. You can choose from different packages based on how much practice your child needs.

5.question: How long does one credit last?
5.answer: Each credit gives you one complete practice call with Bobby. The conversation should last at least 30 seconds to be considered a valid practice session. If a call ends too early, the credit won't be deducted.

6.question: Can I get a refund for unused credits?
6.answer: Credits are non-refundable but don't expire! You can use them anytime for practice sessions with any emergency scenario.

7.question: Do credits expire?
7.answer: No, your credits never expire. Use them whenever you're ready to practice.

8.question: What browsers are supported?
8.answer: Bobby works best on modern browsers like Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge. We recommend using the latest version for the best experience.

9.question: Do I need a microphone?
9.answer: Yes, a microphone is required for voice conversations with Bobby. Make sure you grant microphone permission when prompted.

10.question: How is my child's data protected?
10.answer: We use secure authentication and never store personal information like addresses or phone numbers. Conversations are used only for review and progress tracking.

11.question: Can other users see my child's conversations?
11.answer: No, all conversations are private and only visible to your account.

12.question: How does the scoring system work?
12.answer: Children are scored on clarity, providing location, describing the emergency, and staying calm. Scores range from 0-100, with higher scores earning more XP points.

13.question: What are XP and badges?
13.answer: XP (Experience Points) are earned by completing practice calls. As XP accumulates, children level up and earn badges for achievements like 'Clear Communicator' or 'Fire Safety Expert.'

14.question: Can we replay conversations?
14.answer: Yes! You can review past conversations in the 'Chats' section to see progress and review feedback.

15.question: How is feedback generated?
15.answer: Our AI system analyzes conversations based on age-appropriate criteria and provides personalized feedback on what went well and areas for improvement.

16.question: Can I use Google to sign in?
16.answer: Yes! You can sign up or log in using your Google account for quick access.

17.question: How do I reset my password?
17.answer: Click 'Password playing hide and seek?' on the login page, enter your email, and we'll send a reset link.

18.question: Can I have multiple children on one account?
18.answer: Currently, each account tracks progress for one user. For multiple children, create separate accounts to track individual progress.

19.question: How do I delete my account?
19.answer: Go to Settings > Account > Delete Account. This permanently removes all data, progress, and credits.

20.question: Voice isn't working - what should I do?
20.answer: Check that your microphone is connected and permissions are granted. Try refreshing the page or using a different browser.

termsConditions.title: Terms & Conditions
termsConditions.subtitle: Simple & suitable terms for using Bobby
termsConditions.intro: These Terms and Conditions ('Terms') govern your use of the Bobby web application ('Bobby', 'the app', 'we', 'our'). By accessing or using Bobby, you agree to these Terms.

whatBobbyIs.title: 1. What is Bobby
whatBobbyIs.description: Bobby is an educational practice app that helps children learn how to communicate during emergency situations in a safe, simulated environment.
bulletPoints: not connected to real emergency services
not a replacement for real emergency response
whatBobbyIs.emergencyNote: In real emergencies, always call 999 (UK) or 112 (EU).

whoMayUse.title: 2. Who may use the app
points: Bobby is intended for parents or legal guardians.
Children may use the app only with active parental supervision.
Parents/guardians are responsible for supervising practice sessions and ensuring real personal information is not shared during practice.
Accounts must be created by an adult.

practiceSessions.title: 3. Practice sessions and call credits
practiceSessions.description: Bobby offers practice call packs for emergency communication training.
points: Each practice session uses one call credit.
Each practice call is limited to a maximum duration of 5 minutes.
Unused credits do not expire.
Practice sessions are simulations only and may be ended automatically when time limits are reached.
Conversation transcripts are stored for review and progress tracking.

payments.title: 4. Payments and refunds
points: Payments are processed securely by Stripe.
Prices are clearly shown before purchase.
Due to the digital nature of the service, used practice calls are non-refundable.
Refunds for unused credits may be considered on a case-by-case basis, where required by law.

noAdvice.title: 5. No medical, legal, or emergency advice
noAdvice.description: Bobby is an educational practice tool. It does not provide medical diagnosis, treatment, or professional advice.
noAdvice.safetyPrompts: During practice sessions, Bobby may provide simple, educational safety prompts (for example: stay calm, stay still, unlock the door, or get a nearby adult). These prompts are for learning communication skills and should not be relied upon in real emergencies.
noAdvice.emergencyNote: In a real emergency, always call 999 (UK) or 112 (EU).

availability.title: 6. Availability and changes
points: update or improve the app
change features or pricing
temporarily suspend service for maintenance
availability.note: We aim to keep Bobby available but do not guarantee uninterrupted access.

voluntary.title: Voluntary Service Termination
voluntary.description: If we decide to discontinue Bobby voluntarily, we will provide at least 30 days' notice and offer refunds for any unused credits.

insolvency.title: Insolvency or Bankruptcy
insolvency.description: In the unlikely event of insolvency or bankruptcy, unused credits become unsecured claims in the insolvency proceedings. Refunds, if any, will be determined by the insolvency practitioner in accordance with applicable law.

liability.title: 8. Limitation of liability
liability.description: To the maximum extent permitted by law:
points: Bobby is provided 'as is'
We are not liable for damages resulting from misuse of the app
Bobby should never be relied upon in real emergencies

privacy.title: 9. Privacy
privacy.description: Your use of Bobby is also governed by our Privacy Policy, which explains how we handle data.

governingLaw.title: 10. Governing law
governingLaw.description: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United Kingdom.

contact.title: 11. Contact
contact.description: For questions about these Terms, contact us at:

cookies.description: We use cookies to make your experience awesome! They help us analyze site traffic and personalize content just for you. By clicking "Accept All Cookies", you agree to our use of cookies. Click "Reject All" if you prefer not to share non-essential cookies.
